allow: PowerShell($tools = @{}; foreach\($t in 'python','python3','pandoc','soffice','libreoffice'\){ $c = Get-Command $t -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $tools[$t] = if\($c\){$c.Source}else{'-'} }; $tools.GetEnumerator\(\) | ForEach-Object { "{0} : {1}" -f $_.Key, $_.Value }; $word = $null; try { $word = New-Object -ComObject Word.Application; "WordCOM : OK"; $word.Quit\(\) } catch { "WordCOM : indisponible" })
PowerShell(python -m pip install --quiet python-docx 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 3; python -c "import docx; print\('python-docx OK', docx.__version__\)" 2>&1)

PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 5; "HTTP $\($r.StatusCode\) — page d'accueil OK \($\([math]::Round\($r.RawContentLength/1KB\)\) Ko\)" } catch { "Erreur : $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })
